channel.description: Latest articles from Global Competition Review (globalcompetitionreview.com)

item.title: DOJ approves lifting device and ice deals
item.description: Columbus McKinnon’s $2.7 billion purchase of lifting chain equipment rival Kito Crosby and Reddy Ice’s $126 million acquisition of packaged ice competitor Arctic Glacier both require divestitures, according to the Department of Justice.

item.title: Rinner: “Crying politics” endangers enforcement
item.description: The US antitrust bar risks undermining the predictability of the merger review process by often attributing enforcement actions to politics, former Department of Justice official Bill Rinner has said.

item.title: Ice breaker: The Tipline for 30 January 2026
item.description: The cold snap and icy conditions in Washington, DC, show no signs of breaking up. Assistant Attorney General Abigail Slater, however, is determined to chisel away the anticompetitive harm created by the merger of bagged ice giants Reddy Ice and Arctic Glacier. item.title: Level up: The Briefing for 2 February 2026
item.description: The Netherlands’ new minority government wants to hand the country’s antitrust watchdog call-in and market remedy powers. The coalition revealed on Friday plans to give the enforcer tools to review below-threshold mergers and the ability to impose market-wide remedies following a sector inquiry. The agency has long lobbied previous administrations for the mechanisms, however, the coalition only co...

item.title: Australia fines Chinese citizen over foreign investment breach
item.description: The Federal Court of Australia has ordered a United Arab Emirates-based company and its Chinese former shareholder to pay €8.2 million for violating a foreign investment order requiring the divestment of shares in a domestic mining company with access to rare earths.

item.title: Euclid Law hires Sainsbury’s former antitrust head
item.description: Euclid Law has hired the former head of antitrust at one of the UK’s largest supermarket chains.

item.title: Pinsent Masons recruits Van Bael & Bellis’ UK competition head
item.description: Pinsent Masons has poached the head of Van Bael & Bellis’ UK antitrust practice in London.

item.title: Paul Weiss revamp continues with Davis Polk hire
item.description: Life sciences M&A specialist Jesse Solomon has joined Paul Weiss Rifkind Wharton & Garrison as a partner, leaving Davis Polk & Wardwell after 18 years.

item.title: Smoked Signals: The Tipline for 2 February 2026
item.description: The US antitrust agencies are targeting ephemeral messaging once again. This time, the Federal Trade Commission has accused Amazon executives of deleting Signal messages for three and a half years after the antitrust investigation into its business began. item.title: HPE lobbyists ordered to turn over comms
item.description: Lobbyists hired to secure approval for Hewlett Packard Enterprise/Juniper Networks must share communications they had with the Department of Justice related to the deal’s controversial approval, a California federal court has ruled.
